events.title: Convo Public Room Reopened
events.description: Omniscient temporarily reopened the Public Conversation Room while looking for a JavaScript-proficient developer to resolve issues with the Group Convo Rooms (GCRs). The long-term goal remains to fully transition to GCRs.

events.title: Large DDoS Attacks
events.description: Omniscient informed the community of several high-traffic DDoS attacks targeting HackForums in recent weeks, with virtually no impact on site performance.

events.title: Staff and Vendor Userbars
events.description: Omniscient is gathering feedback on new Staff and Vendor userbar designs, following recent updates to the Admin, UB3R, and L33T userbars.

events.title: Honesty and Dark Moods
events.description: Omniscient publicly addressed recent troll activity and DDoS attempts following the removal of disruptive ex-members. He acknowledged a past comment made during a difficult moment and reaffirmed his 18-year commitment to HackForums.

events.title: Member of the Month
events.description: 6 was awarded Member of the Month.

events.title: Awards
events.description: Confound received the Green Apple award. Cʜᴀᴏs, JoshAllen, PROJECT1, and BaldCunt received the King Decade award.

events.title: Group Userbar Bytes Multiplier
events.description: New exclusive perk: members wearing the H4CK3R$ userbar earn 10x bytes for posts and threads, while The Academy userbar earns 5x bytes. Succubus, Olympians, and Benevolence groups remain listed for sale.
